answer: Each identity registers one orchard plot in one karst cell, locks a 70-credit bond, and gets one certificate via a whisper code tied to its plot key. Each epoch it answers that whisper code, signed with the plot key; a wrong answer revokes the certificate and burns the bond, publicly checked. The first certificate per funding root renews for 32, the k-th for 32+7(k-1), so the 1000th costs 7025 and 1000 fakes pay 3,528,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-certificate ring fails because a code used under another key fails the check and revokes the lending plot too. Honest holders pay 32 per epoch.
